description: checks a CSV header for required column names using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded csv required columns check result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for CSV Required Columns Check as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.
